description: This file defines a FastAPI router for product recommendations, including a single endpoint /recommendations that handles POST requests to fetch recommended products based on provided input parameters.

classes.name: RecommendResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the list of recommended items and a rationale string.

classes.name: RecommendRequest
classes.description: Request model capturing parameters for product recommendations.

methods.name: get_recommendations(payload: RecommendRequest)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to fetch product recommendations based on user input.
